facts.fact: 章首：她回到 Alexander 身边，称这是她一生最深的耻辱。
facts.anchor: I went back to him. This is my deepest shame.

facts.fact: 梦中围攻她的恶魔全是同一张脸——那个开始在她家出没的男人的脸（Nick）。
facts.anchor: They wore the face of the man that had begun to haunt the halls of my home

facts.fact: 她拼出真相：一个人消失、一个人出现，连接两者的正是 Alexander。
facts.anchor: One person disappears, one person appears, and one point of connection between them: Alexander

facts.fact: 她对自己承认，她从不幻想 Alexander 是什么样的人。
facts.anchor: I had no illusions about what Alexander was.

facts.fact: 他喊「走开」时声音里是愤怒，她一部分真的害怕，却仍推门进去。
facts.anchor: There was anger in his voice and a part of me was scared

facts.fact: 她哭着坚持：他选择放过她而不是牺牲她，就是选择她。
facts.anchor: You chose to spare me. You chose me.

facts.fact: 他冷言拒绝：她是空容器、连祭品都不配，只是浪费他的时间。
facts.anchor: You were nothing but a waste of my time.

facts.fact: 结尾：她常觉得自己像一座空房子，但离开身体时是房子暖着她的灵魂。
facts.anchor: It is easy to feel like I am an empty house, sometimes.
